title: Memorial Ghat
description: Memorial Ghat - Memorial Ghat blends neo-classical monumentality with contemporary spatial geometry to create a dignified space of remembrance.
notes: Memorial Ghat is envisioned as a solemn commemorative space inspired by neo-classical architectural principles. The structure features robust fluted columns, a heavy entablature, and symmetrical massing that evoke timeless permanence. Set within a circular landscape layout, the memorial creates a ceremonial procession that guides visitors inward toward the central plinth. The curved retaining walls, stone paving, and stepped forecourt blend classical formality with contemporary terrain design, offering a balanced environment for reflection, tribute, and cultural remembrance.
